# The Modern Schoolman

> [!CAUTION]
> **Publication status:** Appears to have ceased publication — OpenAlex records **no publications since 2012** (checked 2026-07-30, ISSN 0026-8402). This entry is retained for historical reference and for rejection-fallback context, but **should not be recommended as a live submission target**. ### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Res_Philosophica
- https://inmediasphil.wordpress.com/2012/11/08/the-journal-formerly-known-as-the-modern-schoolman/

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **ai_policy.leniency_1_5 / gate**: The Modern Schoolman (ISSN 0026-8402) ceased publication under this name after vol. 89 no. 3/4 (July/October 2012). It was relaunched in 2013 as a new, differently-ISSN'd journal, Res Philosophica (published by SLU Philosophy Dept / Philosophy Documentation Center). No AI-use policy exists for the old title because it does not currently accept submissions.
- **positioning.accepts_now / methods_welcome / framing_required**: No 2024-2026 articles or CFPs exist under The Modern Schoolman name — it is not an active outlet. Any current submission activity would be under Res Philosophica's separate identity/ISSN, which is out of scope for this AI-research entry on 0026-8402.
- **experiential.review_time_months / desk_reject_pct / acceptance_note / reviewer_culture**: SciRev has no entries under this title (searched, see cross_language_checked), and no forum discussion (muchong, fabiaoji, zhihu, r/AskAcademia) references submitting to 'The Modern Schoolman' in any recent timeframe, consistent with it not being a live submission target.
